verdict.rationale: Langfuse is an LLM observability and evaluation platform, so scheduled jobs are a fair axis. The only scheduling evidence is a scheduled Blob Storage Export of data (langfuse-docs-14/29/48). Managed LLM-as-a-judge evaluators run continuously on sampled live traffic (langfuse-docs-42/62), which is automated but not a user-defined recurring schedule. Missing for 10: general user-defined scheduled jobs or workflows, cron-style scheduling of experiments or evaluations, scheduling configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
